name: The Blood of the Bull
inspire:
When you use a daemonforge dice in the Attack roll or Save roll for a friendly fighter, after that Attack, Inspire that fighter.

After an Attack made by a friendly Chaos Duardin ({icon:chaos-duardin}), if the target was adjacent to a friendly Grisk, Inspire that Grisk.

abilities.name: Empowered by Spite
abilities.flavorText: As Zuldrakka and her warriors kill, burn and despoil, their daemon-crafted arms and armour grow ever more powerful.
abilities.rulesText:
You start the game with 1 daemonforge dice.

In your Power step, if a friendly fighter with no Stagger tokens Delves a treasure token, gain 1 daemonforge dice. All daemonforge dice are lost at the end of each battle round.

abilities.name: Enhance Arsenal
abilities.trigger: Immediately after you pick a weapon as part of an Attack made by a friendly Chaos Duardin ({icon:chaos-duardin}), you can use 1 daemonforge dice in the Attack roll.
abilities.rulesText: If you do so, that weapon has +1 Attack dice for that Attack.

abilities.name: Reinforce Armoury
abilities.trigger: Immediately after a friendly Chaos Duardin ({icon:chaos-duardin}) is picked to be the target of an Attack, you can use 1 daemonforge dice in the Save roll.
abilities.rulesText: If you do so, that fighter has +1 Save for that Attack.

abilities.name: Infernal Conflagration
abilities.flavorText: Tokkor's flamehurler spits sentient fire that sticks to flesh and disintegrates the soul.
abilities.rulesText: A friendly Tokkor's ranged weapons (excluding Upgrades) have Grievous ({icon:grievous}) if the target is adjacent.

abilities.name: Hobgrot Cunning
abilities.flavorText: Grisk might be a conniving, murderous back-stabber, but he has his uses...
abilities.rulesText: Rolls of both {icon:swords} and {icon:hammer} are successes in an Attack roll for a friendly Chaos Duardin ({icon:chaos-duardin}) while the target is adjacent to a friendly Grisk.

playstyle: Five Chaos Duardin led by Zuldrakka, a slow but solid core of Move 3 fighters backed by the fragile hobgrot Grisk. Daemonforge dice drive the warband, adding an Attack dice or +1 Save, and spending one Inspires that fighter; more dice come from Delving treasure with unstaggered fighters. Grisk is the force multiplier, making hammers and swords both count as successes against enemies he stands beside. The warband wins by holding treasure and grinding down foes with staggering, Grisk-assisted attacks.
